intent.purpose: slideshow frame: playful high-angle selfie in a small bathroom
intent.scene_concept: front-camera selfie held high above her head in a compact bathroom, one arm raised behind her head
intent.place_type: small home bathroom (not a hotel or spa)
must_stay_true: steep high angle looking down at her
compact bathroom with tiles and a towel rail

appeal.relative_to_inspiration: as attractive as or more attractive than the source posts this scene class came from; the rawness is in the photo, not in her looks
appeal.face: very pretty behind oversized glasses: big eyes, full lips, clear skin
appeal.physique: slim and curvy; the high angle is flattering, not distorting

subject.description: one woman in loungewear taking a quick bathroom selfie
subject.action: holding the phone high with her right hand, left arm bent behind her head
subject.pose: standing, head tilted back and to one side, shoulders turned slightly
subject.gaze: up at the lens over her glasses
subject.expression: playful, eyebrows slightly raised, lips closed
subject.face_visibility: full face, glasses low on the nose

identity.skin: warm light-tan skin, clear skin with fine visible pores and a faint natural flush on the nose
identity.hair: dark-brown hair loosely clipped up with a claw clip, loose strands around the face
identity.face: no makeup except brows; oversized black-framed glasses

physique.proportions: realistic adult proportions; the high angle makes the head larger and the legs shorter
physique.detail: visible from head to upper thighs

items: soft dusty-pink ribbed tank top with small buttons
thin silver chain with a small pendant
wardrobe.fit_and_condition: ribbing stretched and slightly faded, shorts wrinkled

environment.setting: compact home bathroom in the evening
background: white square wall tiles with greyed grout
grey tiled floor with a bath mat half folded over
towel rail with a hanging towel
edge of the sink with a toothbrush cup and a pump bottle
environment.clutter: everyday: towel slung unevenly, a hair tie on the sink edge

camera.position: held high above her head, pointing steeply down

composition.framing: high-angle selfie from head to upper thighs, floor visible
composition.subject_placement: face in the upper third, body tapering toward the bottom
composition.crop: raised elbow cut by the top frame edge

sources: single overhead bathroom ceiling light, cool-white LED
lighting.quality: flat-ish with shadows under the brows and glasses
lighting.exposure: slightly dim, the white tiles near the light slightly hot

color.white_balance: cool-white with a faint green tint from the LED
casts: faint green-cyan cast on the tiles

imperfections: hot highlight on tiles under the light
glasses show a small reflection of the ceiling light
head enlarged by the steep angle

texture.skin: fine pores and a faint natural flush
texture.hair: loose clipped hair with many flyaways
texture.fabric: fine ribbing with stretch and pilling
texture.surfaces: glossy tiles, matte grout, terry towel

anatomy: exactly two arms: one reaching up to the phone out of frame, one bent behind the head
the raised hand behind the head has five fingers where visible
physics: tile grout lines stay straight and converge with the high-angle perspective
geometry.reflections: no mirror in frame; the glasses reflect the ceiling light as a small bright spot
geometry.perspective: steep top-down wide selfie perspective, no fisheye

phone.hold: the phone is the camera and is not visible

typography.scene_text: the pump bottle label is small and turned partly away

brands_and_props.branding_policy: keep natural branding: a real-looking hand-soap label is fine; do not invent new readable text

exclusions: no Apple Watch or any smartwatch
no bent tile lines or warped doors
no text overlays, UI or watermarks
